title: Deposit Payment Limits and Returned-Payment Figures, Home Purchase Agreement
content:
For deposits paid toward a Home Purchase Agreement, the desk reads four collection figures: the single-payment amount above which a deposit payment must come by wire, the largest card payment accepted toward deposits, the returned-payment fee, and the business days allowed to cure a returned payment.

| Collection | Wire required for a single payment above (USD) | Largest card payment toward deposits (USD) | Returned-payment fee (USD) | Business days to cure a returned payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pathway Collection | 10000.00 | 2500.00 | 35.00 | 3 |
| Meadow Collection | 10000.00 | 2500.00 | 35.00 | 3 |
| Heritage Collection | 25000.00 | 0.00 | 35.00 | 3 |
| Crestview Collection | 25000.00 | 0.00 | 35.00 | 3 |
| Summit Collection | 50000.00 | 0.00 | 35.00 | 3 |
| Reserve Collection | 50000.00 | 0.00 | 35.00 | 3 |

**Card cap of zero.** A largest card payment of 0.00 means card is not accepted toward deposits. In the Heritage, Crestview, Summit and Reserve Collections no deposit may be paid by card; in the Pathway and Meadow Collections a card payment toward deposits may not exceed 2500.00.

**Wire threshold.** The wire figure is a strict threshold: a single deposit payment above it must be a wire, and a payment exactly equal to it is not above it.

**Returned payments.** The returned-payment fee figure is the fee for a returned deposit payment, 35.00 in every collection. The cure figure is the business days after notice of a returned payment within which replacement funds and the fee must post, 3 in every collection.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical payments)

- A hypothetical single deposit payment of 10000.00 on a Meadow Collection agreement is not above 10000.00, so the wire figure does not require a wire for it; a payment of 10000.01 is above it and must be a wire.
- A hypothetical card payment of 2500.00 toward a Pathway Collection deposit is within the card figure; 2500.01 is not.
- On a Crestview Collection agreement a card payment of any amount is outside the card figure, because the figure is 0.00.
